column1: # Algeria, the Ministry of Religious Affairs and Waqfs: the 1448 calendars (marw.gov.dz, image
# PDFs read by OCR and checked by eye; profiles-tested.md, data-maghreb-libya). Africa/Algiers.
# Standard Asr. MARW prints no imsak: the fast begins at its Fajr (F+E).
# - The base cities Algiers, Djelfa and Adrar, each at the research's point (the unit's): fit on
#   Algiers's 1448 table; held out, Djelfa's and Adrar's and eight days of Algiers's 1447 calendar
# - The 24 wilayas of Algiers's calendar and the town of Dellys (rulings R230 to R232): FITTED
#   units, each margins of our own over Algiers's method at the wilaya's seat, for 20 km around it.
#   The table a row reads is the one the Ministry derives for the place (Algiers's daily table
#   and the month pages' differences), held only in the private archive
#   (archive/tables/manual/dz-marw/2026-11-13, written by archive/code/manual/dz-marw/
#   marw_wilayas.py from the differences read by eye): none of its minutes is in the app.
#   FIT rows, not held-out ones: the margins were found on these very days (archive/code/manual/
#   dz-marw/marw_fit.py), so a row proves that the fitted margins are never before the place's
#   table on any day held and how late they run (at most 3 minutes), not the engine against a
#   table it has not seen. No day of these 25 places is held out. Nothing is claimed past the
#   days held (ruling R231 as revised): the margins stand through 5 June 2027, the calendar's
#   last day, and after it the app shows every start a whole minute later, sunrise and the end
#   of eating a whole minute earlier, and no figure for the place, until the next calendar is
#   read and fitted. The independent held-out proof stays Djelfa's and Adrar's tables and the
#   eight days of 1447. Largest wilaya first.
# - Oran's band (31-seat, around the fitted unit 31) and Tamanrasset: the tables the ministry
#   derives for them (Algiers and Oran's monthly differences; Adrar and Tamanrasset's
#   half-monthly ones), each fitting its own seat's margins at the seat: fit, nothing held out.
#   Oran's table is so read twice, once by each of its two units, which carry the same margins:
#   by the unit 31, which a place of the wilaya of Oran within 20 km of the seat is given, and by
#   the band 31-seat, which the same point is given when the place's region is not known and
#   which otherwise serves the wilaya beyond the 20 km. The band's "measured" rests on that one
#   row at the seat; nothing is held for a place of the band beyond it. Both bands are of the
#   calendar's days as the 25 places are: the same last day, the same minute after it.
# - The source of the differences: the Wayback Machine's copy of 30 Jul 2026 of the Ministry's
#   Alger.pdf (web.archive.org/web/20260730202403id_/https://marw.gov.dz/media/calendrier/1448/
#   Alger.pdf, taken by the engine survey on 11 Nov 2026; archive/raw/manual/dz-marw/2026-11-11,
#   with its capture note). It is bound to the Ministry's own file by the September round's direct
#   read of 25 Sep 2026: Oran's whole column and the Ramadan page's 30 daily rows are the same
#   in both. The rest of the copy has not been compared with the Ministry's own file: that is
#   to do before the release (the capture note says how).
# Not rows: the OCR stages (dz/*_ocr.txt, dz/*_resolved.txt), the copies of the same calendar
# days (dz_alger_all.txt, dz_adrar.txt, dz_djelfa.txt, agentB/alger_rabi2.txt, off-alger.txt) and
# the differences themselves (differences-alger-1448.txt and its OCR second reading).
